svg.title: Quantum feature processing: QAOA-inspired parameterized quantum circuit
svg.desc: Hadamard initialization, alternating cost (RZ, ZZ) and mixer (RX) layers, CNOT entanglement, Pauli-Z measurements giving expectation values in [-1, 1], and a sigmoid classifier.
